Say you know somebody who has never played an example of a particular genre. What game do you suggest they start with? I started drawing up my own list, talked to some people, and collected these:

  • Squad Tactics: XCOM (2012)
  • Racing Sim: GRID
  • Racing: Burnout Paradise
  • Wargame: Unity of Command
  • 4X: Age of Wonders 3
  • Match-3: Hunie Pop
  • Brawler: Arkham City
  • Text Adventure: Curses
  • Roguelike: Zangband
  • Grand Strategy: Crusader Kings 2
  • Sandbox: Red Faction: Guerrilla
  • Run and Gun FPS: Rise of the Triad (2013)
  • Survival Horror: Amnesia: the Dark Descent
  • RTS: Starcraft 2 (but in my heart, Wargame: Red Dragon)
  • MOBA: DOTA 2
  • Visual Novel: Katawa Shoujo
  • Submarine: Silent Hunter 3 (with Grey Wolves)
  • Football Manager: Football Manager
  • Trap Defense: Orcs Must Die 2
  • Fighting: Ultra Street Fighter 4
  • Platformer: Super Mario 3D World
  • Long Haul Trucking: Euro Truck Simulator 2
  • All-Terrain Trucking: Spintires
  • Isometric Adventure: Wasteland 2
  • JRPG: ? (probably Valkyria Chronicles, but I haven't finished it yet)
  • City-building: ? (probably Cities: Skylines, but I haven't played it yet)
  • Military Sim FPS: ? (probably Arma 2 or 3, but I haven't played them yet)
  • Flight Sim: ? (IL-2 Sturmovik maybe?)
  • Lane Defense: ? (Plants vs. Zombies?)
  • Tower Defense: ? (Revenge of the Titans?)
  • Hidden Object: ? (no idea)
  • Point and Click Adventure: ? (doesn't Telltale still make these?)

Here is what I would change on the list:

  • 4X: Civ5
  • Rouguelike: SlashEM: It's more the spiritual successor of rougue than Zangband is

  • Isometric Adventure: I wouldn't classify this as a genre. I'd have turn based RPG and real time RPG for games like Wasteland 2
